description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p08-arylen-residue.pl.

ROW BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 1 row):
  array.t 172 `assigning to arylen aliased in foreach(scalar $#arylen)`
  -- perl-tests/array.t:563-564

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
    our @foo;
    for (scalar $#foo) { $_ = 3 }
    print "[$#foo]\n";
  perl: [3]
  PCL : [-1]      (the write vanishes, no error)

MECHANISM: `foreach` aliases `$_` to each list element.  `scalar $#foo` is
an arylen-magic lvalue; PCL's foreach list builder copies its VALUE into the
alias slot instead of aliasing the magic cell, so the write lands in a
detached box.  Note `\$#array` write-through itself WORKS (session 218,
`p-arylen-ref` + `p-magic-cell`) -- it is the foreach aliasing path that does
not carry the cell.  Fix area: the foreach list lowering in
`Pl/Parser2.pm` / `p-foreach` in `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp`.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md array.t, "**172** (arylen
aliased in foreach): separate magic-interaction sub-problems."

FAMILY: element aliasing (`docs/not-supported.md` "Sparse arrays (holes),
element aliasing, and SV identity"); this shape is NOT covered there -- the
target is a magic cell, not an array element.
subject: SILENT WRONG (arylen magic): a `foreach` alias to `scalar $#array` does not write through -- `for (scalar $#foo) { $_ = 3 } print $#foo` is 3 in perl and -1 in PCL
